facts.text: SETI Institute reports two LaserSETI stations at AlUla Manara in northwest Saudi Arabia are fully operational.
SETI dates the station installation to 19 August 2026 and its announcement to 22 October 2026; those dates must not be conflated with today's coverage.
According to the project's primary announcement, AlUla is its first observing site in Asia and fifth worldwide; attribute this ranking to SETI.
The system uses wide-field cameras and diffraction gratings to watch large areas of sky for brief optical events; it is not a report of detected extraterrestrial life.
Geographically distributed observations support comparison of events seen from different locations, according to the announcement.
